title: White Bean and Tomato Stew
description: Creamy cannellini beans simmered with crushed tomatoes, garlic, and a fistful of fresh herbs. A pantry-friendly stew that feels both effortless and deeply satisfying.

ingredients.name: baby spinach or lacinato kale
ingredients.notes: kale stripped from stems and roughly chopped

steps.text: Heat olive oil in a large skillet or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add garlic and red pepper flakes, cooking until the garlic is golden and fragrant, about 2 minutes. Don't let it burn.
Pour in crushed tomatoes and broth. Season with salt and pepper. Bring to a steady simmer.

Add the beans and cook, stirring occasionally, until the liquid thickens into a stew-like consistency and the beans are warmed through, about 10 minutes. Smash a few beans against the side of the pot to thicken it further.
Fold in spinach (or kale) and cook until just wilted, about 1 minute for spinach or 2 to 3 for kale.
Remove from heat. Stir in torn basil and parsley. Drizzle generously with olive oil. Serve in shallow bowls with Parmesan and crusty bread for sopping.
